extractor.note: Pass over the sections carrying the theme's terms: the Destruktion as method (§§ 16, 18, 20) and its enactment on Descartes (§§ 21, 31-33, 37), the maxim zu den Sachen selbst (§§ 6, 15), and Husserl's eidetic and transcendental reduction (§§ 48-49).

coverage_note: Covers every section in which the theme's terms occur - §§ 4, 6, 15, 16, 18, 20, 21, 31-33, 37, 48-49 - read in full together with §§ 5, 17, 19, 24, 25-26, 39-41, 42-43, 46-47 and 50 as context for the absences. The Aristotle chapters of Part One (§§ 1-3) and §§ 7-14, 22-23, 27-30, 34-36, 38 and 44-45 were not read in full.

units.claim: Husserl's furthest-driven position defines phenomenology as the descriptive-eidetic science of transcendentally pure consciousness.
units.quote: Heidegger takes Husserl's furthest-driven position in *Ideen I*, where phenomenology is defined as the *descriptive-eidetic science of transcendentally pure consciousness*.

units.claim: Phenomenology's own maxim runs in a definite tendency, and the most hidebound dogmatism can conceal itself behind it.
units.quote: behind the maxim *"zu den Sachen selbst"* the most hidebound dogmatism can conceal itself

units.claim: Under the care for all-bindingness the maxim no longer means making the matters present freely from themselves, but letting the asked-about be encountered within an already-prescribed problematic.
units.quote: can here no longer mean making the matters present freely *from themselves*, prior to a definite way of asking; it means letting the asked-about be encountered *within this already-prescribed problematic*

units.claim: The care for certainty discloses the field "consciousness" factically-historically in Descartes, and the course turns back to that source by way of the Destruktion.
units.quote: it is in Descartes that the care for certainty factically-historically discloses the field "consciousness." With this the course leaves Husserl and turns back, by way of the *Destruktion*, to the source.

units.claim: Both investigations led out of the pre-given discipline to Dasein, and that becoming-free from the discipline is at once a freeing from the handed-down possibilities of determining this being.
units.quote: a *becoming-free from the discipline for Dasein itself*, seizing the possibility of making Dasein the theme of a research determined by Dasein itself. This freeing is at once a freeing *from handed-down possibilities* of determining this being.

units.claim: Destruktion is the freeing by dismantling that leads the concepts back to their proper origin and thereby exposes their inadequacy to Dasein.
units.quote: The freeing by way of dismantling, *Destruktion*, leads the concepts back to their proper origin and thereby exposes their inadequacy to Dasein.

units.claim: Destruktion is no universal historical method but a concrete way arising from the needs of categorial Dasein-research, and it seeks in what it takes up the positive rather than the weaknesses.
units.quote: First, Destruktion is *no universal historical method* but a concrete way arising from the needs of categorial Dasein-research and limited to it; it *seems* purely negative, but it seeks in what it takes up not the weaknesses but *the positive, the productive*

units.claim: What Destruktion criticizes is not the past it discloses but the present, our Dasein insofar as it is covered by a past gone inauthentic.
units.quote: Second, Destruktion is *critical*, but what it criticizes is not the past it discloses; the critique falls on *the present*, our Dasein insofar as it is covered by a past gone inauthentic

units.claim: Destruktion can never be refuting and has sense only as matter-disclosing research into Dasein's being-characters.
units.quote: Fourth, it can never be *refuting*, protecting one's own position by refutation; it has sense only as matter-disclosing research into Dasein's being-characters.

units.claim: The path of removal that ends in truth as value is not contrived for the Destruktion's sake but the path history actually made.
units.quote: This path of removal is not contrived for Destruktion's sake — it is the path *history actually made*, the movement in which the interpretation of the being-as-true runs

units.claim: The correspondence-truth Descartes presupposes and Husserl inherits rests on a formalized ontology of createdness, and that ground is what the Destruktion was after.
units.quote: rests on this formalized ontology of createdness — and this is the ground the *Destruktion* was after.

units.claim: Truth grasped primarily as certainty is the substitution the whole Destruktion was driving at, and Descartes is the one who performs it.
units.quote: Truth grasped primarily as *certainty*: this is the substitution the whole *Destruktion* was driving at, and it is Descartes who performs it.

units.claim: The eidetic reduction of pure consciousness proceeds under the leadership of ontological determinations foreign to consciousness, those of traditional ontology and formal logic.
units.quote: Third, the *eidetic reduction* of pure consciousness proceeds under the leadership of *ontological determinations foreign to consciousness* — the determinations of traditional ontology and formal logic

units.claim: Pure consciousness once won through the transcendental reduction is made a possible domain of a science by importing categories that owe their origin to no analysis of that being's own being-characters.
units.quote: so that pure consciousness, once won through the transcendental reduction, is made a *possible domain of a science* by importing categories that owe their origin *not* to any analysis of *this* being's specific being-characters

absences.expected_because: The section derives the field "consciousness" as the region phenomenology secures for itself, which is the work the reduction is elsewhere said to do; here the region is reached through inner perception and the act-class alone.

This is where the fundamental difference between Husserl's and Descartes' grasp of consciousness is fixed, and the reduction is what would mark that difference; the section fixes it on the disposal of the question of being and the sense of esse certum instead.

The closing section turns the whole indictment into a positive exhibition of Dasein, the point at which the method replacing the criticized reduction would have to be named; it names Verdrehung and the flight of Dasein before itself instead.
